title: Notification Lead Time Timeline
description: Two reminders doing two different jobs: one buys planning time, one prevents forgetting, and a single reminder can only do one of them.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

educational.audience: Club leaders and mentors responsible for family communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given an event date, the learner schedules reminder notifications at appropriate lead times before it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore countdown timeline with a sample message and a timing rationale per reminder
pedagogical.assessment: Give an event date and ask when each reminder goes out and what it must contain.
